title: Update Log
body:
This page functions to catalog all the updates in Oaklands.

Recent Versions

Version 1.79.2

Changed

  • The rainbow tree can now be chopped from all spots, not just the base

Version 1.79.2 (April 1st, 2025)

Version 1.79.1

Fixed

  • Fixed RC Sellner Wheels
  • Fixed freecam not removing the camera preview
  • Fixed the version indicator not showing 1.79.0

Version 1.79.1 (April 1st, 2025)

Version 1.79.0

️April Fool's Day!?

Added

  • To celebrate this update we have added a new present you can find at the Oak Depot. on top of the mannequin. This present will not be returning next year!
  • The mannequins have brought an offering, a RAINBOW TREE!? It goes away after the event!??!? on top of the mannequin.
  • A message was passed around that a potion shipment was making it's way to the Oak Depot. (Permanent Addition) on top of the mannequin.

Fixed

  • I've internally changed how some systems import services, no clue if this will help with performance.
  • A weird bug popped up where lasers wouldn't save. This should hopefully be fixed.
  • We're still looking into the bug where players fall through their base when loading. No updates on this yet!

Version 1.79.0 (April 1st, 2025)

Version 1.78.1

Changed

  • Made the placement preview in the build mode more visible
  • Changed lighting as an experiment
  • Fruit Baskets can no longer be used whilst sitting

Fixed

  • Fixed the Flora Laura drop
  • Fixed Magma Cave Lighting
  • Fixed wires & string lights not being able to go on structures

Version 1.78.1 (March 16th, 2025)

Version 1.78.0

️St. Patrick's Day!

Added

  • Until March 31st, a bunch of awesome exclusive content is coming to Oaklands to celebrate St. Patrick's Day! The new shop, Rainbow's End, has all of the exclusive content! Unlike the other shop items, the presents will NOT be returning next year! They will be unwrappable 2 days before the end of the event, get stocking! You can place your shop items in front of Gurt & Duckie, and make your purchase there.
  • Two new clover trees are here! Friva Clover is a beautiful pink clover that can be found in the Flowering Meadows. This clover will still be obtainable, yet much rarer, after the event. Golden Clover is limited to the St. Patrick's Day event, and will return next year. It is INCREDIBLY rare, and can be found all over the map! Good luck.
  • Gold pots can be found all over the map, they give you special coins that can be sold for money. They also have a guaranteed drop for a Golden Oaklands Coin, which comes in 8 unique styles.
  • Leprechauns have taken over Finlay island! They don't seem to be very keen around humans, usually because they try to trap them. Use a jar to collect them, if you can get to them!
  • Two new fruit baskets have been added to the game. One can be found at the Oak Depot, and the other one at Flora Laura! They allow you to collect & store fruit easily.
  • Thanks to Chrythm, Oaklands now has a bunch of new songs for the main region. These songs will randomly play! We have also decided to bring back the old Oaklands song. We hope you enjoy!

Changed

  • A bunch of UI has been stylized to match the Oaklands theme. There's still more to go, and this is only half of the plan for revamping the UI.
  • The material gun now has a search bar in the UI interface! You're welcome.
  • We're experimenting with a feature to give different dialogue voices to different NPCs. This currently only supports one voice, but we want to expand this more soon!
  • PC Users can now quickly open the Build Menu by pressing Ctrl + B. We're still assessing how we can implement this for controller. Stay tuned!
  • Build Mode now supports region selections, use a bounding box to select mass amounts of schematics at once!

Fixed

  • We've made a bunch of small client performance improvements, changed how some internal systems work, and reduced part counts. This hopefully will decrease memory usage & CPU timing.
  • Freecam can no longer enter blocked properties, no more annoying trolls!
  • Wind Lines & Shaking Leaves are now disabled by default for new users. We recommend disabling this if you want higher FPS.
  • No more popped tires! The vehicle tires should now be fixed, this happened due to a change Roblox made.

Version 1.78.0 (March 15th, 2025)

Version 1.77.0

️Oaklands Progress Report!

Added

  • A weird cave opening has appeared on Finlay Island... what could this mean?
  • This doesn't seem normal.
  • Note: We are using this as an experiment/preview as to how a zone system work!

Changed

  • We're still working diligently on quests. Unfortunately we had to postpone our target release date for them, but we promise it will be worth the wait! Thank you for always sticking with us.
  • grUdge says goodbye, and til next year. We hope you enjoyed this year's Valentine's content, we tried some new tech we'd like to use in the future!
  • We've reworked the lava caverns to be much more visible, hopefully this makes it easier to navigate!
  • It turns out the stock market system hasn't been correctly working, it now is! whoops.

Version 1.77.0 (February 24th, 2025)

Version 1.76.0

️Valentine's Day Update

Added

  • The Hearty Exchange is here until the 24th of February, buy lovely goods and spread the Valentine's love! For playing you will receive a badge and an exclusive property sign!
  • Head on over to grUdge, spend $2000, and give away a box of chocolates to any user, even if they're offline! (experimental)
  • If you've ever wanted to BE grUdge, InvertedReality made some UGC for our beloved pig! You can find this in the store.
  • @Azyloval & @20Chetti01 worked on this awesome Valentine's base preset. It's pretty wonderful if you're not that great at building!

Version 1.76.0 (February 14th, 2025)

Version 1.75.1

Added

  • Added invite rewards (These require the user to join your server, and fully complete the tutorial without skipping. I wasn't able to test if it fully works yet, due it not allowing them to join sub-servers or private servers.)

Changed

  • The newsletter now shows in the main menu
  • Added rare Goblin & Skeleton trophy drops
  • There is now new main menu scenes!
  • Reworked the trust menu UI

Fixed

  • The Gravity & Fusion Coil now use their gravity behavior again
  • Adjusted the font for the topbar
  • Increased acidsmog damage 1.5 -> 1.85
  • Enemies will stop sitting in seats if they can
  • All the goblin NPCs should no longer be moveable

Version 1.75.1 (February 8th, 2025)

Version 1.75.0

️Rise of the Goblin...

Added

  • The Acidlands is Here! We're happy to announce that the Acidlands is FINALLY returning, with more content than before! It contains a variety of content such as a new quest, fightable enemies, weapons, merchants, and more! This expansion has been in the works for a WHILE now, so we hope you enjoy the new area. We weren't able to get everything we wanted to done, so you may see a few small additions over the coming days. Thanks to The Overtime Gamer for the initial concept.
  • This update has reintroduced a type of content we experimented with last Halloween, enemies! These enemies have different fighting patterns, such as ones that can use projectiles. Weapons (not tools) can be used to attack the enemies, which can be found at different shops within the Acidlands (or as incredibly rare drops). Unfortunately we weren't able to implement custom animations in time, but we'd like to add those next. We have a long way to go with this new system, there's a bunch we want to add! The Goblins worship the Acid Crown... Do you have what it takes to become worthy?

Changed

  • The Robux Store Menu has been revamped into a new design, this should hopefully fix a lot of the UX issues the last one had, and throws a new coat of paint on the menu!
  • We've decided to test a new monetization strategy, bundles. We noticed that they did really well for the Christmas update, so we'd like to permanently add this style of monetization to Oaklands. These are only beneficial for newer players, so no need to worry!

Version 1.75.0 (February 1st, 2025)

Version 1.74.0

️It's our anniversary!

Added

  • Welcome to 2025, where Oaklands is now 2 years old! We have decided to celebrate by adding a new permanent location, as well as limited time content that will also return next year!
  • The Classic Biome has all the awesome classic materials, including a new material... good luck finding it! A video has been provided on how to get to the area as well!
  • The Balloons, Cake, and Party Hats are available for a week! A countdown timer, as well as the items, can be found at the Oak Depot! Have fun celebrating...
  • Two new retro tools have been added, they're quite simple, but a nice collectors item!

Changed

  • The Gift of Universal Studs can now be dyed to be used as a building material! So many color opportunities...
  • Lately we've been taking a pretty long break, but we're ready to get back into things. Our next update should be quests! It's been a long time of planning, and we're nearing the point of creating some awesome things to show. Are you ready!?
